formal_status: AI-assisted written mathematical derivation plus exact rational checks; no independent human review, not Lean formalized and not an executable whole-integer circuit.
periodic_geometry_review_scope: AI-assisted skeptical review by the boundary and compiler agents: broad forward needs only nonwrapping interior inverses; narrow periodic inverses use strict row diagonal dominance; cyclic border is held until the final Schur solve. Not independent human review.
model: xag-straightline-v1; nonuniform constants, wiring and precomputation free; all input-dependent fixed-point operations charged by the operation ledger.
geometric_ratio: rho_shape=t/s=1+theta; distinct from the positive XOR/AND cost slider rho_cost.

common_gate.axis_period_condition: Every source/target axis period is at least p^256; physical period cuts remain phase-cell boundaries.

spectral_bounds.primitive_gate_and_inverse_gate_entry_up: p^64; this does not bound reciprocals of arbitrarily tiny shear entries

physical_reference_matrix.broad_contiguous_interior_section_invers: p^19 before rounding, at mostp^20 after rounding
physical_reference_matrix.broad_required_section_scope: Only nonwrapping contiguous selected-target interiors inside one physical phase cell. The broad operator uses F only as a matrix application; no broad F inverse or LU-prefix bound is needed.
physical_reference_matrix.narrow_all_principal_section_inverse_upp: 16p^2<=p^3; applies to periodic principal sections too
physical_reference_matrix.required_eliminated_principal_section_in: p^32, for narrow all required sections and broad interior sections only
physical_reference_matrix.elimination_geometry: Narrow: all principal sections by inherited strict row diagonal dominance. Broad: only nonwrapping dyadic interiors, W away from physical phase-cell/period boundaries.
physical_reference_matrix.reference_rounding_and_truncation_error_: 2^-60p in both induced 1 and infinity norm
physical_reference_matrix.periodic_warning: Period length alone does not make the row0/column(t-1) wrap entry small. Narrow periodic inverses use strict row dominance; broad applies the cyclic Schur matrix without inversion. The boundary solver explicitly retains the first/last W coordinates as a border until its final Schur solve.

interior_circuit.coefficient_and_inverse_after_shear_repl: p^144 per axis before the whole-factor p^-100 normalization
interior_circuit.six_H_qualification: For U(t), |t|<=p^64, split U(t)=U(t+c)U(-c), c=2p^64+1; both six-H denominators have magnitude at least p^64. Merge adjacent diagonal layers. Routing is fixed wiring in this model.
interior_circuit.tensor_synchronization: At most12 completed factors per axis can be synchronized into12 global tensor rounds by padding with identities. No additional factor d is multiplied after counting ceil(d/g) groups per round.

deferred_normalization.normalization_rule: Scale the entire square factor including its identity block; active-block-only normalization changes the operator and is disallowed.
deferred_normalization.restoration: Defer all scalar gains to final integer recovery; the source original Gaussian gain 2^(2alpha^2) is included.

working_width.target_FFT_guard: The raw unnormalized target FFT can grow by T. The extra2log2T covers its prefix/suffix growth and final1/T fractional positions. Round the completed normalized target FFT back to the q-grid, charging at most10w per coordinate; this is included in the FFT twiddle/rounding count row.
working_width.coefficient_word_width: A q-fractional-bit complex coefficient also needs its sign and integer-range bits; use at most w.
working_width.product_temporary_warning: Full scalar product temporaries need up to 2w+O(1) bits (at most 66p+O(1)); their full width must be passed to the HvH product helper. The 33p bound is not a claim about raw multiplication temporaries.
working_width.exact_native_interface: The supplier's all-size C0*d guard covers child recursion and direct reserved-axis completion. Native C/H calls are exact on the dyadic grid, with no numerical rounding inside them.

rounding_envelope.boundary_contract: At F>=1024ell, each completed solve has absolute error<=p^1024*(1+X)*2^-F and every data temporary is bounded by p^512*(1+X). This includes an explicitly held cyclic border.
rounding_envelope.logical_round_count_upper: At most100*p^2, hence at most p^3 at the common gate, after identity padding and grouping. A complete banded solve counts as one error module because its local-residual proof already covers its full loop; this is not a bound on the number of individual scalar operations.
rounding_envelope.variable_pointwise_product_error: For |z|,|v|<=1 and each error<=e<=1/8, product error<=2e+e^2+8*2^-q<=4e; completed inverse adds at most2e, hence total<=6e. Four full real variable products and additions/rounding are separately charged.
rounding_envelope.consequence: The final recovered coefficient error is less than 2^-15p, hence less than1/4, subject to the stated encoding, pointwise-product and source factorization contracts.
